title: Online furniture shop – drivers of monthly regional revenue
text: An online furniture shop explains monthly revenue per region (k€) with search engine advertising spend (SEA, k€), number of influencer posts, average delivery time (days) and region dummies. Region West is the baseline. R² = 0.71, adjusted R² = 0.68.

title: Mini case Lumo – smart home security cameras
text: Lumo sells AI-powered indoor and outdoor cameras with an optional cloud subscription (video storage, person recognition). Its competitive strength is its AI software; it has little experience in retail pricing battles.

Trend report extract ("Safe at Home"): Fear of burglary has risen with media coverage of break-ins, and more elderly parents live alone far from their children. At the same time, cheap AI chips have made person recognition affordable, and everyone controls their home from a smartphone. Consumers now expect security that is effortless to install, works without a technician – and does not turn their home into a data mine: privacy scandals of connected devices made headlines across Europe.
Lumo surveyed 1,200 households and ran a cluster analysis on the importance (1–7) of four product aspects.
